requirements.evidence: Defaults + range fallback in Queue::defaultPrefixFor (app/Models/Queue.php:148-159); custom-map precedence in prefixForPriority (Queue.php:164-167); canonical-key regex '/\A(0|[1-9]\d*)\z/', single-letter '/\A[A-Z]\z/' and effective-letter uniqueness incl. uncovered 0/10/20 defaults (Queue.php:181-216); empty map -> null and validation on every save via saving hook (Queue.php:127-132); map stays out of #[Fillable]. Ticket::nextCode filters by queue, prefix 'like' and whereDate issue_date, scans by id desc skipping malformed codes (app/Models/Ticket.php:244-266). IssueTicket reads the clock once and uses it for code day, issued_at and issue_date (app/Actions/IssueTicket.php:30-46). Migration adds nullable, backfills DATE(issued_at), makes NOT NULL, swaps the unique index, with a guarded down() (2026_10_29_100001...:16-45). Factory derives issue_date from issued_at and allocates by priority/day, keeping explicit codes (database/factories/TicketFactory.php:311-335). UpdateQueue gains priorityPrefixMap (null/[]/validate) and turns the error into a ValidationException on 'priority_prefix_map' before mutating (app/Actions/UpdateQueue.php:71-95). The issue_date cast is 'date' and docs/CHANGELOG are updated.

conventions.evidence: Domain write goes through the UpdateQueue Action with the existing Gate authorization (UpdateQueue.php:73); the mass-assignment list is deliberately unchanged; every migration has a down(); docs/business-rules.md, docs/database-schema.md and CHANGELOG.md under [Unreleased] are updated; PHPDoc on touched public methods. The migration filenames have round timestamps (2026_10_29_100000/100001), which suggests they were not created with make:migration, and the backfill/index-swap migration has no test.

security.evidence: priority_prefix_map is not added to #[Fillable] (Queue.php:110), and a test proves update() ignores it (QueuePriorityPrefixTest.php:721-727). UpdateQueue authorizes before validation or writes (UpdateQueue.php:73). Input is strictly validated, including the trailing-newline case through \z (Queue.php:190-196). No UI or Livewire surface is added.

tests.evidence: New QueuePriorityPrefixTest covers the default and range letters, custom precedence, canonical storage and null for an empty map, mass-assignment protection, 12 invalid-map datasets, an unchanged queue on an invalid save, UpdateQueue set/keep/clear, ValidationException with the right key and no change, and an employee denial. TicketDisplayCodeTest covers independent prefixes, a custom letter, the midnight restart with Carbon::setTestNow, factory issue_date defaults and day allocation, the mismatch rejection and explicit codes. IssueTicketTest is updated for N codes and adds the legacy-A case (IssueTicketTest.php:601-611). Missing: tests for the migration backfill and its down() guard.

simplicity.evidence: Lean overall: one normalizer reused by both the model hook and UpdateQueue (UpdateQueue.php:80, Queue.php:130), and nextCode reuses the existing scan pattern. Small extras: the filter_var overflow guard on top of the regex (Queue.php:190), and the factory throws on an issue_date/issued_at mismatch (TicketFactory.php:315-317) where defaulting alone would do.

readability.evidence: Clear names (normalizePriorityPrefixMap, defaultPrefixFor, $issuedOn), short methods, comments explain why (e.g. 'One clock read: ...' IssueTicket.php:29; 'Validate before mutating anything' UpdateQueue.php:75). Matches the sibling style and leaves no dead code.

scope.evidence: Every file serves the task. The docs/api/totem.md edit (lines 455-471) only updates the example code and its description so the docs stay correct; the API itself is not changed.

issues.explanation: No test covers the backfill of issue_date from DATE(issued_at), the unique-index swap, or the down() refusal when a code repeats across days.
The round migration timestamps (100000/100001) suggest the files were hand-written rather than generated with php artisan make:migration, as the conventions require.
Throwing on a mismatched explicit issue_date is stricter than the task needs; defaulting from issued_at already keeps the two aligned.
The docs say the day is UTC, but the code uses the app timezone through now(); this holds only if app.timezone is UTC.

review.summary: The change adds priority-based code letters (default N/P/E with range fallback, plus a validated, non-mass-assignable per-queue map managed through UpdateQueue), restarts the sequence daily per queue and letter with a backfilled issue_date and a new unique index, and updates the factory, docs and CHANGELOG. It meets every requirement and the contract, with thorough tests for validation, authorization, sequencing and the midnight boundary. The only gaps are an untested migration and minor nits, so it is approvable with nits.
